newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate edges up 40 bps to 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate edges up 40 bps to 10.8 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate edged up 40 basis points to 10.8 percent on Thursday despite weaker demand from the usual borrowers on the money market.
Dealers said settlements shrank to 30.5 million kuna, of which most were fresh borrowings. Supply stood at 35 million.
The interbank rates ranged between 10.5 percent for call money and up to 15 percent for one-month loans.
Insurers charged 9.0 percent for renewed one-week deals.

The central bank's kuna midrates for Friday eased further to 5.9982 versus 5.9917 against the dollar, but was slightly firmer at 3.5627 to the German mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
